definitions.explanation: A formal expression of regret for wrongdoing, often public or official.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{謝罪|しゃざい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company issued an official apology.

examples.japanese: {謝罪|しゃざい}⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: They held an apology press conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{謝罪|しゃざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
{謝罪|しゃざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to apologize formally)

USAGE:
Used for formal or serious apologies, especially:
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧{謝罪|しゃざい} (official apology)
- {謝罪|しゃざい}⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧ (apology press conference)
- {謝罪|しゃざい}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (written apology)
- {謝罪|しゃざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to demand an apology)
- {謝罪|しゃざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧ (to accept an apology)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, formal apologies often involve bowing deeply. Public figures and companies often hold press conferences to apologize for scandals or problems.

REGISTER:
Formal. For casual apologies, use ⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧ or ⟦ごめんなさい→ごめんなさい：00931_gomennasai⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧ - to apologize (general)
- ⟦{詫|わ}びる→詫びる：14174_wabiru⟧ - to apologize (humble)
- ⟦{陳謝|ちんしゃ}→陳謝：07994_chinsha⟧ - formal apology (even more formal)
